c74object.name: lp.nn~
c74object.digest: Degrade signal resolution and sample rate
c74object.description: lp.nn~ reduces bit resolution (positive nn), replaces low-order bits with dither (negative nn) and can reduce the effective sample rate.

objarg.name: esr
objarg.digest: Effective sample rate in Hz (0 = no reduction)

method.name: float
method.description: In the 2nd inlet: NN Factor. In the 3rd inlet: Effective Sample Rate.

method.name: tattle
method.digest: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same)
method.description: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same).
